metadata.question: Does the cloud cover increase in the Rocky Mountain region (specifically centered at coordinates 50.332360, -116.939238, with a radius of 60 km) on December 5th, 2020, compared to December 2nd, 2020?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy (Collection, Date, Location).
- Region: 60 km radius circle around point (lon=-116.939238, lat=50.332360).
- Dates: exact days [2020-12-02, 2020-12-03) and [2020-12-05, 2020-12-06).
- Collections (in order): COPERNICUS/S2_SR, COPERNICUS/S2, LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2.
- If no images on exact day for all collections, widen to ±1 day (3-day window) for S2_SR.

2. Masking strategy (Should I mask clouds? Or is the question about clouds?).
- We need to detect clouds, not mask them. For S2, use QA60 bits 10 (cloud) and 11 (cirrus). For Landsat 8 L2, use QA_PIXEL bits 1 (dilated cloud), 2 (cirrus), 3 (cloud). Cloud fraction = sum(isCloud)/count(valid pixels), computed at 1000 m scale.

3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3).
- If collections empty after recovery attempts: C1.
- If total valid pixels after processing = 0: C2.
- If computed values are null/NaN/invalid: C3.
- Otherwise compare Dec 5 vs Dec 2: if cloud% increases, A; else B.

const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  // Helpers for Node API
  function getInfoAsync(obj) {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      obj.getInfo((res, err) => {
        if (err) reject(err);
        else resolve(res);
      });
    });
  }

  // Geometry & parameters
  const lon = -116.939238;
  const lat = 50.332360;
  const radiusM = 60000;
  const region = ee.Geometry.Point([lon, lat]).buffer(radiusM);
  const scale = 1000; // to keep computations light and avoid timeouts

  // Dates
  const d1 = '2020-12-02';
  const d2 = '2020-12-05';

  function dayRange(dateStr) {
    const start = ee.Date(dateStr);
    return { start: start, end: start.advance(1, 'day') };
  }
  function widenRange(dateStr, daysBefore, daysAfter) {
    const center = ee.Date(dateStr);
    return { start: center.advance(daysBefore, 'day'), end: center.advance(daysAfter, 'day') };
  }

  // Build daily cloud image for S2 QA60
  function buildCloudImageS2(col) {
    // QA60 bits: 10 (cloud), 11 (cirrus)
    const cloudBit = 1 << 10;
    const cirrusBit = 1 << 11;
    const perImg = col.map(function(i) {
      const qa = i.select('QA60');
      const isCloud = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudBit).neq(0)
        .or(qa.bitwiseAnd(cirrusBit).neq(0))
        .rename('isCloud');
      // mask to valid data
      return isCloud.updateMask(qa.mask());
    });
    // Union of coverage; max => any cloud flag in overlapping scenes
    return ee.ImageCollection(perImg).max();
  }

  // Build daily cloud image for Landsat 8 L2 QA_PIXEL
  function buildCloudImageL8(col) {
    // QA_PIXEL bits: 1=dilated cloud, 2=cirrus, 3=cloud
    const b1 = 1 << 1;
    const b2 = 1 << 2;
    const b3 = 1 << 3;
    const perImg = col.map(function(i) {
      const qa = i.select('QA_PIXEL');
      const isCloud = qa.bitwiseAnd(b1).neq(0)
        .or(qa.bitwiseAnd(b2).neq(0))
        .or(qa.bitwiseAnd(b3).neq(0))
        .rename('isCloud');
      return isCloud.updateMask(qa.mask());
    });
    return ee.ImageCollection(perImg).max();
  }

  async function computeCloudForDate(dateStr) {
    // Try S2_SR exact day
    let range = dayRange(dateStr);
    let src = 'COPERNICUS/S2_SR';
    let col = ee.ImageCollection(src).filterBounds(region).filterDate(range.start, range.end).select(['QA60']);
    let size = await getInfoAsync(col.size());

    if (size === 0) {
      // Try S2 L1C exact day
      src = 'COPERNICUS/S2';
      col = ee.ImageCollection(src).filterBounds(region).filterDate(range.start, range.end).select(['QA60']);
      size = await getInfoAsync(col.size());
      if (size === 0) {
        // Try Landsat 8 exact day
        src = 'LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2';
        col = ee.ImageCollection(src).filterBounds(region).filterDate(range.start, range.end).select(['QA_PIXEL']);
        size = await getInfoAsync(col.size());
        if (size === 0) {
          // Widen window for S2_SR ±1 day
          src = 'COPERNICUS/S2_SR';
          range = widenRange(dateStr, -1, 2); // 3-day window [d-1, d+2)
          col = ee.ImageCollection(src).filterBounds(region).filterDate(range.start, range.end).select(['QA60']);
          size = await getInfoAsync(col.size());
          if (size === 0) {
            // Widen S2 L1C ±1 day
            src = 'COPERNICUS/S2';
            col = ee.ImageCollection(src).filterBounds(region).filterDate(range.start, range.end).select(['QA60']);
            size = await getInfoAsync(col.size());
            if (size === 0) {
              // Widen Landsat 8 ±1 day
              src = 'LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2';
              col = ee.ImageCollection(src).filterBounds(region).filterDate(range.start, range.end).select(['QA_PIXEL']);
              size = await getInfoAsync(col.size());
              if (size === 0) {
                // No imagery found even after recovery attempts
                return { status: 'C1', msg: `${dateStr} Images: 0` };
              }
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }

    // Build cloud image depending on source
    let cloudImg;
    if (src === 'LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') {
      cloudImg = buildCloudImageL8(col);
    } else {
      cloudImg = buildCloudImageS2(col);
    }

    // Compute stats
    const sumDict = cloudImg.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
      geometry: region,
      scale: scale,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    });
    const countDict = cloudImg.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
      geometry: region,
      scale: scale,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    });

    let cloudPix = await getInfoAsync(sumDict.get('isCloud'));
    let totalPix = await getInfoAsync(countDict.get('isCloud'));

    if (cloudPix === null || totalPix === null) {
      return { status: 'C2', msg: `${dateStr} No valid pixels after processing.` };
    }
    if (totalPix === 0) {
      return { status: 'C2', msg: `${dateStr} Valid Pixels: 0` };
    }

    const frac = cloudPix / totalPix;
    if (!Number.isFinite(frac) || frac < 0 || frac > 1) {
      return { status: 'C3', msg: `${dateStr} Invalid fraction.` };
    }

    return {
      status: 'OK',
      date: dateStr,
      source: src,
      images: size,
      cloudPix: cloudPix,
      totalPix: totalPix,
      cloudPct: frac * 100.0
    };
  }

  try {
    console.log('Region: 60 km radius around (50.332360, -116.939238)');
    const res1 = await computeCloudForDate(d1);
    const res2 = await computeCloudForDate(d2);

    // Handle failure cases
    if (res1.status !== 'OK' || res2.status !== 'OK') {
      if (res1.status === 'C1' || res2.status === 'C1') {
        console.log(res1.msg || '');
        console.log(res2.msg || '');
        console.log('C1: Empty Collection (No images found in date/location for one or both comparison points).');
        console.log('C1: Empty Collection (No images found in date/location for one or both comparison points).'); // final line
        return;
      }
      if (res1.status === 'C2' || res2.status === 'C2') {
        console.log(res1.msg || '');
        console.log(res2.msg || '');
        console.log('C2: No Valid Pixels (Images exist, but after cloud masking/processing, 0 pixels remain).');
        console.log('C2: No Valid Pixels (Images exist, but after cloud masking/processing, 0 pixels remain).'); // final line
        return;
      }
      if (res1.status === 'C3' || res2.status === 'C3') {
        console.log(res1.msg || '');
        console.log(res2.msg || '');
        console.log('C3: Calculation Failure (Result is None, NaN, or invalid).');
        console.log('C3: Calculation Failure (Result is None, NaN, or invalid).'); // final line
        return;
      }
      // Fallback: syntax/other error
      console.log('D: Processing issue encountered.');
      console.log('D:'); // final line minimal tag (though spec suggests including brief)
      return;
    }

    // Print concise evidence
    console.log(`${res1.date} Using: ${res1.source} | Images: ${res1.images} | CloudPix: ${res1.cloudPix} | TotalPix: ${res1.totalPix} | Cloud%: ${res1.cloudPct.toFixed(2)}`);
    console.log(`${res2.date} Using: ${res2.source} | Images: ${res2.images} | CloudPix: ${res2.cloudPix} | TotalPix: ${res2.totalPix} | Cloud%: ${res2.cloudPct.toFixed(2)}`);
    const delta = res2.cloudPct - res1.cloudPct;
    console.log(`Delta Cloud% (Dec 5 - Dec 2): ${delta.toFixed(2)}`);

    // Final decision
    if (delta > 0) {
      console.log('A: Yes');
    } else {
      console.log('B: No');
    }
  } catch (e) {
    console.log(`D: ${e}`);
    console.log('D:'); // final line
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
